title: SUBSIDY STEP 2: consumers persist as basal food descends 0.05 -> 0.01?

identity.note: The probe always ran from the current checkout. A historical arm spec applied here is a settings replay, not a reproduction of its original figure.

preregistration.hypothesis: Step 2a (0.05) kept consumers on 16/18 with flux on 18/18 while three-guild endpoints rose descriptively 6/18 -> 9/18. A further 5x descent should continue shifting the income base toward producers/grazing; the paying graze link carries consumers through.
preregistration.prediction: cons > 0 on at least 12/18 seeds at tick 6000 (machine criterion) AND grazeEnergy > 0 sustained on at least 12/18 (human-read from B/D lines). Coexistence NOT predicted.
preregistration.falsification: FALSIFIED if cons = 0 on 7 or more of 18 seeds: the cut outran the link — hold the subsidy at 0.05, do not descend to 0, return to link/viability work. If consumers persist but grazeEnergy = 0 on >=7/18, the config is incoherent: stop, do not interpret persistence as success.
preregistration.notPredicted: Endpoint guild composition, coexistence rates, capture shares, per-win sizes. Descent to 0 is a separate arm, registered only if this one passes.
confoundsControlled: Same 18-seed panel, horizon, engine as graze-subsidy05; the ONLY difference is basalFoodPerCell 0.05 -> 0.01
Matched comparison against the archived 0.05 run isolates the subsidy effect
conservation enforced per seed at 0.5%; a seed above it fails the run rather than reporting

criteria.statement: consumers > 0 at tick 6000 on at least 12/18 seeds
